text: Gotcha for future BEHIND-branch fixes: PUT /pulls/<n>/update-branch creates a merge commit authored via the API with no DCO Signed-off-by trailer, which fails the DCO Sign-Off check even though every original commit was properly signed off (hit this on PR #5464). Fix: don't use update-branch -- rebase the PR branch onto the base locally (git rebase origin/v1-development) and force-push instead, which keeps the original signed commits and avoids introducing an unsigned merge commit. Rebased #5464 onto current v1-development as 612555f50, CI re-running.
